name: Social Ops Bot
tagline: Sorts the dead weight out of your X follows without hitting real people
description: Works through the accounts attached to your profile and separates them: dormant handles and obvious junk on one side, genuine people on the other. Anything carrying a verification badge is left alone by default, awkward cases sit in a queue waiting on your decision, and whoever survives gets filed by audience.
author: JC
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
